renders._yaml:
- component: figure
  title: F1 per callset, event and base
  description: |-
    Each bar is the F1 score of one callset against the truth set, with the event level and the base level side by side. It answers how well the large variant calls match the truth, and whether they match in count or in the bases they cover.
    How to read: a high event bar means the callset finds the right events, and a high base bar means it covers the right bases. A callset good at one level and poor at the other has events that match in position but not in extent.
    Note: Wittyer counts an event as a match by percentage or base-pair distance and requires the genotype to match by default, and counts every overlapped base at the base level. The cited README states no cut-off for F1, so none is drawn.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Illumina/witty.er/master/README.md
  visu_type: bar
  dict_kwargs:
    x: label
    y: f1
    color: stats_type
    barmode: group
    labels:
      label: Callset
      f1: F1 score
      stats_type: Scoring level

- component: table
  title: Large variant benchmark
  description: |-
    Each row is a callset at one scoring level with its precision, recall and F1, and the caller, the truth set and the strata when the table carries them. It answers the numbers behind the bars.
    How to read: compare recall and precision at each level to see whether a callset misses variants or adds false ones.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Illumina/witty.er/master/README.md
